briefdescription.para: LLT is packed into 64 bits as follows: isScalar : 1 isPointer : 1 isVector : 1 with 61 bits remaining for Kind-specific data, packed in bitfields as described below.

detaileddescription.para: As there isn't a simple portable way to pack bits into bitfields, here the different fields in the packed structure is described in static const *Field variables. Each of these variables is a 2-element array, with the first element describing the bitfield size and the second element describing the bitfield offset.

briefdescription.para: This is how the bitfields are packed per Kind:

listitem.para: Invalid: gets encoded as RawData == 0, as that is an invalid encoding, since for valid encodings, SizeInBits/SizeOfElement must be larger than 0.
Vector-of-pointer (isPointer == 1 && isVector == 1): NumElements: 16; SizeOfElement: 16; AddressSpace: 24; Scalable: 1;
